lesson: Repeated integration gap: exclusive logfile ownership was tested in isolated stages but not their actual composition. Earlier delivered_peer prepare and execute shared stdout.log; encoder parent build and worker build also shared build.stdout.log. Different source paths, same namespace collision class.
prior_delivered_peer_failure_scope: Parent reported FileExistsError before validator execution. Its external receipt has planned validator_calls=32, not observed completions; this appendix does not reinterpret that field as executed calls.
repair: Only parent main two stdout/stderr filename expressions gain parent_. Original worker run() and every command-log reader remain unchanged; this supersedes the earlier unexecuted worker-prefix repair suggestion.
regression: Actual original parent file opens + deterministic fake worker invoking original run() exclusive file opens for configure/build/dependents/imports/compiler_dependencies. Legacy build collision is reproduced; all three repaired parent modes complete the composed file sequence. No actual compiler/extension/native workload.
scope: Does not prove a real encoder build will succeed; fresh build002 still requires root authorization. No old receipt or source overwritten.
